CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_example (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    source_key varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    "order" smallint NOT NULL,
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    mode varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    primary_stack varchar(128),
    stacks text[] NOT NULL,
    target_concepts text[] NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_order_range CHECK ("order" BETWEEN 1 AND 32767),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_status_check CHECK (status IN (0, 1)),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_mode_check CHECK (mode ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_stacks_nonempty CHECK (cardinality(stacks) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_concepts_nonempty CHECK (cardinality(target_concepts) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_primary_stack_member CHECK (
        primary_stack IS NULL OR array_position(stacks, primary_stack) IS NOT NULL
    ),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_order_unique UNIQUE (lesson_id, "order") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_example_lesson_idx
    ON lesson_example (lesson_id, "order");

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_example_i18n (
    example_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson_example(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    i18n_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES i18n(id),
    title varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (example_id, i18n_id),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_i18n_title_nonempty CHECK (btrim(title) <> ''),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_i18n_description_nonempty CHECK (btrim(description) <> '')
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lesson_example_relation (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    source_key varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_example_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson_example(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    target_example_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson_example(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    relation varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    primary_stack varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    stacks text[] NOT NULL,
    concepts text[] NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_relation_distinct_examples CHECK (source_example_id <> target_example_id),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_relation_kind_check CHECK (
        relation IN (
            'implementation',
            'practice',
            'comparison',
            'reference',
            'prerequisite',
            'continuation',
            'see_also'
        )
    ),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_relation_stacks_nonempty CHECK (cardinality(stacks) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_relation_concepts_nonempty CHECK (cardinality(concepts) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_relation_primary_stack_member CHECK (
        array_position(stacks, primary_stack) IS NOT NULL
    ),
    CONSTRAINT lesson_example_relation_identity_unique UNIQUE (source_example_id, target_example_id, relation)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_example_relation_source_idx
    ON lesson_example_relation (source_example_id);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lesson_example_relation_target_idx
    ON lesson_example_relation (target_example_id);
